function sql(value) {
  if (value === undefined || value === null || String(value).trim() === '') return 'NULL';
  return "'" + String(value).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'";
}
const body = $json.body || $json;
const publicationJobId = String(body.publicationJobId || body.publication_job_id || '').trim();
const avatar = String(body.avatar || '').trim();
const scene = String(body.scene || '').trim();
const requestedLimit = Number(body.limit || 10);
const limit = Number.isFinite(requestedLimit) ? Math.min(Math.max(Math.trunc(requestedLimit), 1), 50) : 10;
const uuidRegex = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
if (publicationJobId && !uuidRegex.test(publicationJobId)) {
  return [{ json: { query: "SELECT false AS ok, 'Invalid publicationJobId' AS error, '[]'::jsonb AS jobs, 0 AS count;" } }];
}
const where = [];
if (publicationJobId) where.push('pj.publication_job_id = ' + sql(publicationJobId) + '::uuid');
if (avatar) where.push('pj.avatar = ' + sql(avatar));
if (scene) where.push('pj.scene = ' + sql(scene));
const whereSql = where.length ? 'WHERE ' + where.join(' AND ') : '';
const query = `
WITH selected_jobs AS (
  SELECT pj.*
  FROM publication_jobs pj
  ${whereSql}
  ORDER BY pj.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, pj.created_at DESC
  LIMIT ${limit}
), hydrated AS (
  SELECT
    sj.*,
    gj.job_id AS generation_job_id,
    gj.avatar AS generation_avatar,
    gj.scene AS generation_scene,
    gj.asset_type AS generation_asset_type,
    gj.platform AS generation_platform,
    gj.status AS generation_status,
    gj.run_mode AS generation_run_mode,
    gj.started_at AS generation_started_at,
    gj.completed_at AS generation_completed_at,
    gj.prompt_pack AS generation_prompt_pack,
    gj.result_payload AS generation_result_payload,
    car.asset_id AS latest_asset_id,
    car.object_path AS latest_asset_object_path,
    car.bucket AS latest_asset_bucket,
    car.status AS latest_asset_status,
    car.review_notes AS latest_asset_review_notes,
    car.metadata AS latest_asset_metadata,
    car.created_at AS latest_asset_created_at,
    selected.asset_id AS publication_selected_asset_id,
    selected.object_path AS publication_selected_asset_object_path,
    selected.bucket AS publication_selected_asset_bucket,
    selected.status AS publication_selected_asset_status,
    selected.review_notes AS publication_selected_asset_review_notes,
    selected.metadata AS publication_selected_asset_metadata,
    selected.created_at AS publication_selected_asset_created_at,
    COALESCE(attempts.generation_attempts, '[]'::jsonb) AS generation_attempts
  FROM selected_jobs sj
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT *
    FROM generation_jobs gj
    WHERE gj.job_id::text = sj.metadata->>'generationJobId'
       OR gj.request_payload->>'publicationJobId' = sj.publication_job_id::text
       OR gj.request_payload->>'publication_job_id' = sj.publication_job_id::text
    ORDER BY gj.started_at DESC NULLS LAST, gj.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, gj.created_at DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
  ) gj ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT *
    FROM canonical_asset_registry car
    WHERE car.asset_id::text = sj.metadata->>'latestGeneratedAssetId'
       OR car.metadata->>'publicationJobId' = sj.publication_job_id::text
    ORDER BY car.created_at DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
  ) car ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'generationJobId', gj_all.job_id,
      'avatar', gj_all.avatar,
      'scene', gj_all.scene,
      'assetType', gj_all.asset_type,
      'platform', gj_all.platform,
      'status', gj_all.status,
      'runMode', gj_all.run_mode,
      'startedAt', gj_all.started_at,
      'completedAt', gj_all.completed_at,
      'failedAt', gj_all.failed_at,
      'createdAt', gj_all.created_at,
      'updatedAt', gj_all.updated_at,
      'providerPromptId', gj_all.result_payload->>'providerPromptId',
      'providerStatus', gj_all.result_payload->>'providerStatus',
      'assetId', gj_all.result_payload->>'assetId',
      'objectPath', gj_all.result_payload->>'objectPath',
      'errorMessage', gj_all.error_message
    ) ORDER BY gj_all.created_at DESC NULLS LAST, gj_all.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST) AS generation_attempts
    FROM generation_jobs gj_all
    WHERE gj_all.request_payload->>'publicationJobId' = sj.publication_job_id::text
       OR gj_all.request_payload->>'publication_job_id' = sj.publication_job_id::text
       OR gj_all.job_id::text = sj.metadata->>'generationJobId'
  ) attempts ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT *
    FROM canonical_asset_registry selected
    WHERE selected.asset_id::text = sj.metadata->>'selectedAssetId'
    LIMIT 1
  ) selected ON true
)
SELECT
  true AS ok,
  COALESCE(jsonb_agg(
    jsonb_build_object(
      'job', jsonb_build_object(
        'publicationJobId', publication_job_id,
        'avatar', avatar,
        'scene', scene,
        'format', format,
        'objective', objective,
        'businessProfile', business_profile,
        'assetType', asset_type,
        'status', status,
        'brief', brief,
        'promptPack', prompt_pack,
        'publishingPack', publishing_pack,
        'createdAt', created_at,
        'updatedAt', updated_at
      ),
      'generation', CASE WHEN generation_job_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE jsonb_build_object(
        'generationJobId', generation_job_id,
        'avatar', generation_avatar,
        'scene', generation_scene,
        'assetType', generation_asset_type,
        'platform', generation_platform,
        'status', generation_status,
        'runMode', generation_run_mode,
        'startedAt', generation_started_at,
        'completedAt', generation_completed_at,
        'promptPack', generation_prompt_pack,
        'resultPayload', generation_result_payload
      ) END,
      'generationAttempts', generation_attempts,
      'latestAsset', CASE WHEN latest_asset_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE jsonb_build_object(
        'assetId', latest_asset_id,
        'objectPath', latest_asset_object_path,
        'bucket', latest_asset_bucket,
        'status', latest_asset_status,
        'reviewNotes', latest_asset_review_notes,
        'metadata', latest_asset_metadata,
        'qa', latest_asset_metadata->'qa',
        'createdAt', latest_asset_created_at
      ) END,
      'selectedAsset', CASE WHEN publication_selected_asset_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE jsonb_build_object(
        'assetId', publication_selected_asset_id,
        'objectPath', publication_selected_asset_object_path,
        'bucket', publication_selected_asset_bucket,
        'status', publication_selected_asset_status,
        'reviewNotes', publication_selected_asset_review_notes,
        'metadata', publication_selected_asset_metadata,
        'qa', publication_selected_asset_metadata->'qa',
        'createdAt', publication_selected_asset_created_at
      ) END
    )
    ORDER BY updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, created_at DESC
  ), '[]'::jsonb) AS jobs,
  COUNT(*)::int AS count
FROM hydrated;
`;
return [{ json: { query } }];
